decisions.reason: The reference-based theme is already captured by the source Requirement; it does not change the headers' required content or presentation standard.
Applying one design across all files does not change the required footer presence or content.
The visual-theme decision does not change which result drivers must appear or their communication goal.
The source decision does not change the front-page panel, its required fields, or its prominence requirement.
The common design reference does not alter the required vehicle identifier.
The decision applies a common theme to the four files but does not change the variant codes, editability, or selection basis.
Selecting a common visual reference does not establish any change to the reusable asset package or its delivery contents.
The visual-theme decision does not change the recommendations' action-led structure or priority tiers.
Applying the same design to every file does not change the requirement for straightforward PDF export.
The source decision does not change the scoring table format or its required fields.
The common visual theme does not change which customer-specific fields must be editable or the editability standard.
